title: Compact Iron
description: Automate your iron production with 8 tiers of upgradeable Golem Forges and 20 unique modules.
body:
Compact Iron - Advanced Golem Forging

Compact Iron is a high-tech automation mod that lets you generate resources using specialized Golem Forges. Start with basic wooden machinery and work your way up to legendary Netherite-infused forges!

### Features:

8 Tiers of Forges: Each material (Wood, Stone, Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Obsidian, Netherite) has its own speed and upgrade capacity.

Dynamic Balancing: Higher tiers are significantly faster but require more investment.

20 Unique Upgrades: Customize your production with Speed, Fortune, Auto-Ejectors, Compactors, and even Ender-Transport!

Visual Progress: Each forge features a custom GUI with progress bars and time estimates.

 How to get started:

Craft a Wooden Golem Forge using oak planks, iron ingots, and a carved pumpkin.

Place it down and watch it generate iron over time.

Use the generated resources to upgrade your forge to the next tier!
